units.rawText: Dolls don't have to reminisce. My past is stored in my neural cloud as memory data.
units.displayText: Dolls don't have to reminisce. My past is stored in my neural cloud as memory data.

spans.text: Dolls don't have to reminisce. My past is stored in my neural cloud as memory data.

units.rawText: There's nothing worth looking back on. The only memorable thing was how I felt when my neural cloud overloaded.
units.displayText: There's nothing worth looking back on. The only memorable thing was how I felt when my neural cloud overloaded.

spans.text: There's nothing worth looking back on. The only memorable thing was how I felt when my neural cloud overloaded.

units.rawText: Spirited and numb. Impulsive and ruthlessly calm.
units.displayText: Spirited and numb. Impulsive and ruthlessly calm.

spans.text: Spirited and numb. Impulsive and ruthlessly calm.

units.rawText: Our neural clouds are not refreshed when our bodies are replaced. They gradually decay the same way humans age.
